components.name: Conversation Composer
components.description: The docked, paper-white natural-language entry point for all work.
components.html: Enter 发送 · Shift + Enter 换行
components.css: .ds-composer { width:min(100%,760px); padding:12px 12px 10px 16px; border:1px solid #bfc9d9; border-radius:16px; color:var(--ink,#172033); background:var(--paper,#fff); box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(31,47,82,.1); font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color:#7894d9; box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(31,47,82,.13); } .ds-composer textarea { width:100%; min-height:50px; max-height:132px; padding:1px 2px 8px; resize:none; border:0; outline:0; color:inherit; caret-color:var(--blue,#2457d6); background:transparent; font:400 .91rem/1.55 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color:#59667e; } .ds-composer-footer { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; } .ds-composer-footer span { color:#59667e; font-size:.68rem; } .ds-composer-footer button { width:36px; height:36px; border:0; border-radius:10px; color:#fff; background:var(--blue,#2457d6); cursor:pointer; } .ds-composer-footer button:hover { background:#1948bc; } .ds-composer-footer button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(36,87,214,.28); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Task Pulse
components.description: The signature conversation-embedded bridge from a message into durable task state.
components.css: .ds-task-pulse { position:relative; display:block; width:min(100%,680px); padding:17px 18px 15px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#c7d0df); border-radius:14px; color:var(--ink,#172033); background:var(--paper,#fff); text-align:left; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-task-pulse::before { position:absolute; top:17px; bottom:17px; left:0; width:1px; background:var(--amber,#a76208); content:''; } .ds-task-pulse:hover { border-color:#9fafd0; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(35,54,95,.1); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-task-pulse:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-task-pulse:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(36,87,214,.28); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-status { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; color:var(--muted,#667085); font-size:.72rem; font-weight:650; } .ds-status i { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--amber,#a76208); } .ds-status time { margin-left:auto; font-weight:480; } .ds-task-pulse strong, .ds-task-pulse small { display:block; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-task-pulse strong { margin-top:12px; font-size:.94rem; letter-spacing:-.012em; } .ds-task-pulse small { margin-top:6px; color:var(--muted,#667085); font-size:.78rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-stage { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:5px; margin-top:16px; } .ds-stage i { height:3px; border-radius:3px; background:var(--blue,#2457d6); } .ds-pulse-foot { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:11px; color:#59667e; font-size:.7rem; } .ds-pulse-foot b { color:#4767ae; font-weight:620; }

components.name: Waiting Status Label

components.name: Task Filter
components.description: The two-state segmented control used to switch active and completed work.
components.css: .ds-task-filters { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:4px; width:300px; padding:4px; border:1px solid #d2d9e4; border-radius:11px; background:#e4e8ef; } .ds-task-filters button { min-height:36px; border:0; border-radius:8px; color:var(--muted,#667085); background:transparent; font:620 .77rem/1 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-task-filters button:hover { color:var(--ink,#172033); } .ds-task-filters button.ds-is-active { color:var(--ink,#172033); background:#fff; box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(28,43,76,.08); } .ds-task-filters button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(36,87,214,.28); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Task List Item

components.css: .ds-task-list-item { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; width:100%; min-height:70px; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:12px; border:0; border-radius:12px; color:var(--ink,#172033); background:transparent; text-align:left; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-task-list-item:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.78); } .ds-task-list-item:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(36,87,214,.28); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-task-list-item > i { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--blue,#2457d6); } .ds-task-list-item span { min-width:0; } .ds-task-list-item strong, .ds-task-list-item small { display:block; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-task-list-item strong { font-size:.82rem; font-weight:650; } .ds-task-list-item small { margin-top:5px; color:var(--muted,#667085); font-size:.69rem; } .ds-task-list-item b { color:#8d98aa; font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:400; }

narrative.overview:
Pegas is a calm handoff from intent to durable action. Cool paper surfaces and ink-dark text keep the conversation primary; cobalt appears only where the interface is carrying work forward, while compact status signals make long-running activity legible without turning the product into a dashboard.

The system pairs a task-pulse conversation entry with an on-demand personal control center. Work grows naturally out of a message, stays visible in the conversation, and reveals its runs, timing, output, and errors only when the user asks for depth. Precision comes from thin rules, measured density, consistent curved geometry, and restrained motion—not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Conversation-first hierarchy with task state embedded in the flow.
Cool, quiet paper layers anchored by deep ink and restrained cobalt.
Progressive disclosure from task pulse to a focused task workbench.
Compact, plain-language status cues with semantic color support.
Responsive continuity: the same information model becomes a full-screen task detail on mobile.

rules.name: The One Execution Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks actions and active execution; do not introduce another brand accent for equivalent emphasis.

rules.name: The Semantic Restraint Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red communicate state only; they never become decorative surface colors.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep all interface language in the Inter family; hierarchy comes from weight, scale, spacing, and placement.

rules.name: The Human First Rule
rules.body: User-facing task and status language stays plain; runtime vocabulary belongs inside the expanded task workbench.

rules.name: The Conversation Continuity Rule
rules.body: A task begins in the conversation and opens into more detail without asking the user to choose a project or management mode first.

rules.name: The Flat Until Active Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces rely on tone and border; elevation appears only for focus, hover, or panel transition.

dos: Do keep the conversation and composer visually dominant on first view.
Do express task progress as a compact pulse in the conversation before revealing runs and metadata.
Do use cobalt selectively for active execution, actions, focus, and progress.
Do preserve the same task information hierarchy across desktop and mobile.
Do pair every semantic color with plain-language status copy.
donts: Don't make users enter a project, task manager, or runtime view before they can speak naturally.
Don't turn the default view into a dense dashboard of counts, logs, or system controls.
Don't use glow, glass, decorative gradients, or saturated color fields.
Don't expose sessions, workers, or model selection in the conversation-first layer.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces when a cool tonal layer or fine rule can define structure.
